def analyze(p):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    (br,bc),seps,csep=blocks_(inp)
    cnts=Counter(v for r_ in inp for v in r_)
    bg=max(cnts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]
    sepv=inp[list(seps)[0]][0]
    mk=[v for v in cnts if v not in (bg,sepv)][0]
    B=[]
    for a,b in br:
        row=[]
        for c,d in bc:
            pts=[(i-a,j-c) for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if inp[i][j]==mk]
            row.append(pts)
        B.append(row)
    H=len(br); W=len(bc)
    marks=set((i,j) for i,row in enumerate(out) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v!=1)
    # candidate sets: single marker p placed at block cell with ± sign; also shape size>1 blocks? print details first
    return B,H,W,marks
for p in ['1','2','3']:
